questions.question: What is the difference between measured, indicated and inferred mineral resources?

facts: they express increasing geological confidence: measured highest, inferred lowest, based on sampling density and continuity
measured and indicated resources can be converted to reserves once economic and technical factors (modifying factors) are applied
inferred resources cannot be converted directly to reserves and carry the most uncertainty
truth.tolerance: the key points must be present and correct; extra correct detail is fine
truth.source: general knowledge, written before any system was asked

questions.question: How is lithium extracted from brine compared with hard-rock spodumene?

facts: brine: pumped to surface evaporation ponds for many months and then chemically processed into carbonate or hydroxide
spodumene: mined, crushed and concentrated, then roasted at high temperature and leached or converted to lithium chemicals
brine is generally lower cost but slower and depends on climate and brine chemistry; hard rock is faster but more energy intensive
truth.tolerance: the key points must be present and correct; extra correct detail is fine
truth.source: general knowledge, written before any system was asked

questions.question: What is a carbonatite and why does it matter for rare earths?

facts: an igneous rock made mostly of carbonate minerals, usually associated with alkaline complexes
carbonatites host some of the largest rare earth deposits (for example Bayan Obo and Mountain Pass)
rare earths occur in minerals such as bastnaesite and monazite; niobium is often co-produced
truth.tolerance: the key points must be present and correct; extra correct detail is fine
truth.source: general knowledge, written before any system was asked

questions.question: Why is it hard to separate rare earth elements from each other?

facts: their chemical properties are very similar (trivalent ions of similar size, the lanthanide contraction)
separation uses solvent extraction in many repeated stages
it is costly and produces waste streams (including radioactive thorium or uranium) and most capacity is in China
truth.tolerance: the key points must be present and correct; extra correct detail is fine
truth.source: general knowledge, written before any system was asked

questions.question: What does the Herfindahl-Hirschman Index measure and how is it calculated?

facts: it measures market or supply concentration
it is the sum of the squared market shares (in percentage points) of the participants
it ranges from near 0 to 10,000, where 10,000 is a single supplier
truth.tolerance: the key points must be present and correct; extra correct detail is fine
truth.source: general knowledge, written before any system was asked

questions.question: What is a skarn deposit?

facts: it forms where hot fluids from an intrusion react with carbonate rocks such as limestone (contact metasomatism)
it contains calc-silicate minerals such as garnet and pyroxene
skarns can host copper, iron, tungsten, zinc-lead or gold
truth.tolerance: the key points must be present and correct; extra correct detail is fine
